answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 8935 Country: India Title: Assalamu alaikum Wa rehmatullah I want to know about pf which is deducted from our salary and after adding the same amount by the company submitted in pf office. if pf is not avoidable, what about for intrest which is given on pf amount. Question: Assalamu alaikum Wa rehmatullah I want to know about pf which is deducted from our salary and after adding the same amount by the company submitted in pf office. if pf is not avoidable, what about for intrest which is given on pf amount. Answer ID: 8935 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1139/1139=M/1429) The PF amount deducted from your salary, if it is deducted without your choice and an equal amount is added from the company then the addition on the total amount will not be considered interest, it is a gift from the company and it is permissible to receive and use it. But, if the PF amount is deducted with your choice then the additional amont received on it will be considered is interest and unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
